**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
An interconnect architecture based on topological manifolds (e.g., higher-dimensional surfaces) for wafer-scale integration of computing and memory elements. Offers a scalable, low-latency physical substrate for TCC, supporting emergent computation through non-Euclidean connectivity patterns.
